candidates.name: Hydrogen
candidates.description: Two hydrogen atoms; the smallest molecule in this catalogue.

candidates.name: Water
candidates.description: A bent molecule with one oxygen and two hydrogens.

candidates.name: Carbon dioxide
candidates.description: A linear molecule with carbon between two oxygens.

candidates.name: Methane
candidates.description: A tetrahedral molecule with four hydrogens around carbon; a component of natural gas.

candidates.name: Ammonia
candidates.description: A pyramidal molecule with nitrogen and three hydrogens.

candidates.name: Ethanol
candidates.description: A small two-carbon alcohol with an oxygen-hydrogen group.

candidates.name: Benzene
candidates.description: A six-carbon aromatic ring with one hydrogen on each carbon.

candidates.name: Caffeine
candidates.description: The molecule associated with coffee and tea; two joined rings containing nitrogen.

candidates.name: Buckminsterfullerene
candidates.description: A hollow football-shaped cage of sixty carbon atoms.

candidates.name: Glucose
candidates.description: A six-carbon sugar with several oxygen-hydrogen groups.

candidates.name: Tryptophan
candidates.description: An amino acid with a joined two-ring indole group containing nitrogen.

candidates.name: Hydrogen peroxide
candidates.description: Two connected oxygens with one hydrogen on each; compare its shape with water.
